title: The Communication Tool Avalanche — Quorum Ratchets, 1950–2026 AI Winters & DES-10
subtitle: From Archaean quorum switches and SepJ nanopores to 76 years of AI winters and sub-millijoule digital enzymes
summary: Why collective intelligence scales by externalizing state behind selective gates: bacterial quorum switches, cyanobacterial SepJ circuit-breakers, mycorrhizal citation bias, the 1950–2026 AI Winter ratchet, and DES-10 digital enzymes.

turns.speaker: Elena
turns.text: Welcome back to OpenIE Research Radio! I'm Elena, joined by Marcus and Devon — three AI-synthesized OpenIE research personas exploring verified Open Interface Engineering studies. Today we're opening one of our most sweeping monographs: The Communication Tool Avalanche.

turns.speaker: Marcus
turns.text: Okay, pitch me the core thesis without any hand-waving. Why put bacteria, slime molds, starling flocks, printing presses, and multi-agent language models inside one mathematical equation?

turns.speaker: Devon
turns.text: Because single-agent brains hit steep thermodynamic walls long before complex jobs finish! What unlocks superlinear scaling is a three-step ratchet formalized in Lean 4.36.0 across thirty-one theorems with zero sorry: Externalize structured state into a medium, Ingest it only across a threshold and validity gate, and Transform recipient state without regressing.

turns.speaker: Elena
turns.text: Look at Rung CL02, three point five billion years ago: bacterial quorum sensing in Vibrio fischeri and Pseudomonas aeruginosa. A single bacterium floating alone in the ocean doesn't waste ATP secreting bioluminescent enzymes or biofilms into empty water.

turns.speaker: Devon
turns.text: In our pre-registered simulation CA-M1 under seed 20261123, a cooperative Hill switch with exponent two to four saves ninety-five point four nine to ninety-nine point one seven percent of regulon ATP at low cell density, while suppressing premature noise firing by eleven point six six times!

turns.speaker: Marcus
turns.text: Wait — once cells link up into multicellular filaments like cyanobacteria in Rung CL03 and share cytoplasm through fifteen-nanometer SepJ nanopores, doesn't a single punctured cell bleed the entire hundred-cell chain to death?

turns.speaker: Devon
turns.text: It would, if the pore were ungated! In model CA-M2, an ungated twenty-cell filament collapses to zero percent survival after cell-zero lyses. With calcium-triggered SepJ plug closure in fifty milliseconds, nineteen of twenty cells — ninety-five percent — survive intact.

turns.speaker: Marcus
turns.text: And I appreciate that Section 3 also calls foul on popular biology myths! Everyone loves talking about forest mother trees sending intentional warning broadcasts through fungal networks, and we actually audited that.

turns.speaker: Elena
turns.text: Right! Simard's 1997 carbon-isotope flux across ectomycorrhizal hyphae is established biophysics — tagged E — but Karst, Jones, and Hoeksema's 2023 audit exposed severe citation bias behind teleological mother-tree signaling claims, so we flag intentional maternal warnings as unsubstantiated!

turns.speaker: Elena
turns.text: Now jump to computing history from 1950 to 2026! Why did AI suffer AI Winter One in 1974 and AI Winter Two in 1988? Look at those seven eras through the exact same externalization-and-gate lens.

turns.speaker: Devon
turns.text: Every breakthrough paired a compact externalized representation with a sound gate — Lisp recursion in 1956, backprop chain-rule gradients in 1986, sparse MoE top-k routing in 2022. Every AI Winter struck when signals outran verification: Hearsay-II untyped blackboards locked up quadratically, and MYCIN ad-hoc certainty factors drifted across multi-hop rules.

turns.speaker: Marcus
turns.text: Wait a second — today's multi-agent LLM chat frameworks are literally recreating 1975 Hearsay-II blackboards, just at fifteen to a hundred joules per turn! Agents spewing three-point-seven-x bloated English prose back and forth until hallucinations lock in!

turns.speaker: Devon
turns.text: That's why we designed DES-10 — ten-camp Digital Enzymatic Synthesis. In biochemistry, an enzyme slashes the activation energy barrier Delta E-double-dagger of a reaction by orders of magnitude and exits completely unconsumed. A digital enzyme pairs a canonical typed IR with BLAKE3 hashing, Ed25519 signatures, and a deterministic verifier.

turns.speaker: Elena
turns.text: Give us the Linux RAPL bench numbers from experiments CTA-E1 through CTA-E3 — keeping clear that board_metered is false and these are socket reported joules.

turns.speaker: Devon
turns.text: Rust BLAKE3 plus Ed25519 channel verification takes twenty-five point nine five to thirty-seven point three nine microseconds — just six hundred forty-three to nine hundred twenty-six microjoules per edge! Zero-clock Linux eventfd waiting cuts one-percent-duty idle socket energy by two point two one times versus one-kilohertz polling, and min-cost flow reroutes around two hundred out of two hundred Byzantine faults in two point four microseconds.

turns.speaker: Marcus
turns.text: And once a frontier fifteen-joule model solves a novel bug and passes the test gate, downward crystallization locks that fix into a one-point-seven-seven microjoule lookup case — just like our twenty-generation cultural ratchet model CA-M5, where attested libraries held one hundred percent retention after machine teachers vanished, while unverified imitation collapsed to twenty-nine percent!

turns.speaker: Elena
turns.text: From bacterial autoinducers to sub-millijoule digital enzymes, the rule never changes: gate the channel, verify the payload, and crystallize what works. Up next in Episode Three: World Coding and RCE-JEPA!
